self_review.evidence: Both loaders exist and write a wav for duration_s (ezaudio.py:39-54,71-87; moss_sfx.py:33-56). Unit tests with fakes are in test_sfx_loaders.py. The legion smoke (e2e file plus post-deploy check sfx-loaders-legion-e2e) instruments the out_of_band R2

git diff --stat origin/milestone/m2-first-film-alterlab-launch-film...HEAD shows only 4 new files and +5 lines of JSON. test_model_loaders.py, test_layout.py, test_host_wheel.py and test_model_assets.py pass

D1-D5 delivered. git diff on models.py, _base.py, loaders/__init__.py, src/, host/pyproject.toml is empty (P1, P2, P4, P5). test_sfx_loader_modules_import_no_torch covers P3. forgedock check passes V1-V5

decisions: EzAudio at 86f1826 takes ckpt_path/vae_path but reads its config relative to cwd and the T5 name from it: construct in the source dir with load_yaml_with_includes wrapped to point at the local flan-t5-xl
EzAudio length is an integer number of seconds (1-10, audio_frames = length*50 must be int), then trimmed or padded
moss_sfx reuses ezaudio.write_wav instead of a new shared module, to stay within the deliverables
Duplicate export `load` in ezaudio.py and moss_sfx.py kept: FACTORIES (models.py:49) resolves '<family>:load' per module and the contract fixes the name (P1); separate modules, no collision

rejected.approach: chdir into the EzAudio weights dir so its relative ckpts/ paths resolve
rejected.why: the config yml lives in the source checkout, and explicit ckpt/vae kwargs exist
no measured token rate; precedent fixes 1024 for 10 s clips

hotspots.why: monkeypatches api.ezaudio.load_yaml_with_includes during construction; depends on the pinned EzAudio commit
